definition_zh: 编造；捏造；制造
definition_en: to invent something false, or to manufacture something
core_image: 车间里，工人把原料拼成一件成品；另一间办公室里，有人把一段从未发生的经历写成报告
scene: 他把整段引语都编了出来，没人说过那句话。He fabricated the whole quotation, and nobody had said it.
sceneCN: 这里指「编造」（第 1 个义项：凭空造出不存在的内容）；句意：他把整段引语都编了出来，其实没人说过那句话。

senses.title: Invent falsely
senses.definition: to invent false information on purpose
senses.definitionCN: 故意造出不存在的信息
senses.example: The report was fabricated to hide the loss.
senses.exampleCN: 那份报告是为了掩盖亏损而捏造的。
senses.why: Latin fabrica meant a workshop; making something in a workshop became making something, and then making something false.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 fabrica 意为作坊；在作坊里做东西引申为「制作」，再引申为「造假」。

senses.title: Manufacture
senses.definition: to build or assemble a product from parts
senses.definitionCN: 用零件组装成产品
senses.example: The plant fabricates steel frames for bridges.
senses.exampleCN: 这家工厂制造桥梁用的钢架。
senses.why: The neutral manufacturing sense is the older one; the false sense grew out of it.
senses.whyCN: 中性的「制造」义更早，造假义是从它长出来的。

senses.title: Construct an excuse
senses.definition: to put together an excuse or explanation that has no basis
senses.definitionCN: 拼凑出没有根据的借口或解释
senses.example: He fabricated an excuse about traffic and arrived late anyway.
senses.exampleCN: 他编了个堵车的借口，结果还是迟到了。
senses.why: An excuse is assembled from pieces the way a product is assembled, but the pieces are not real.
senses.whyCN: 借口像产品一样被拼装起来，只不过零件不是真的。

intro.en: Fabricate comes from Latin fabrica, a workshop, and fabricari, to build.
intro.cn: fabricate 来自拉丁语 fabrica（作坊）与 fabricari（建造）。

items.en: Fabrica means a workshop or a craft.
items.cn: fabrica 意为作坊或手艺。

items.en: Fabricari means to build or shape something.
items.cn: fabricari 意为建造、塑造。

items.en: Fabricate enters English meaning to construct.
items.cn: fabricate 进入英语时意为建造。

items.en: The sense of inventing something false appears.
items.cn: 「编造虚假内容」的义项出现。

items.en: Legal and journalistic use keeps both senses alive.
items.cn: 法律与新闻用法让两个义项都活着。

items.en: Data and evidence are the most common objects today.
items.cn: 如今最常见的宾语是数据与证据。

note.en: Fabricate sits between manufacture and invent.
note.cn: fabricate 处在「制造」与「发明」之间。

normalIntro.en: Fabric is cloth; fabricate is to weave something together, true or not.
normalIntro.cn: fabric 是布；fabricate 是把东西织起来，真假都行。

normal.en: The company fabricated the data to win the contract.
normal.cn: 公司伪造数据以拿下合同。

normal.en: He fabricated a story about being abroad that week.
normal.cn: 他编了个那周在国外的故事。

normal.en: The workshop fabricates metal parts for cars.
normal.cn: 这家作坊制造汽车金属零件。

normal.en: The whole interview was fabricated from start to finish.
normal.cn: 整篇采访从头到尾都是编的。

normal.en: Compare invent: invent creates something new, fabricate usually creates something false.
normal.cn: 对比 invent：invent 造新东西，fabricate 通常造假。

abstract.en: Picture hands weaving a cloth that hides what is behind it.
abstract.cn: 想象一双手织出一块布，把背后的东西遮住。

abstract.en: Imagine a factory line turning raw metal into a finished frame.
abstract.cn: 想象流水线把生金属做成成品框架。

abstract.en: Think of an excuse assembled from spare parts that do not fit.
abstract.cn: 想象一个用不配套的零件拼出来的借口。

examples.en: The study was withdrawn after reviewers found fabricated data.
examples.cn: 审稿人发现数据造假后，这项研究被撤稿。

examples.en: The plant fabricates parts for wind turbines.
examples.cn: 这家工厂制造风力涡轮机的零件。

examples.en: She fabricated an alibi that collapsed under questioning.
examples.cn: 她编了个不在场证明，一问就垮了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「fabric + ate」——把布一样的材料拼起来，拼不真就是编造；只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 fabrica（作坊）+ fabricari（建造）→ fabricate（建造；编造），核心义「把零件拼成形」。

sensesIntro.en: Fabricate first means inventing something false, then building a product, then assembling an excuse.
sensesIntro.cn: fabricate 先指编造虚假内容，再指制造产品，最后指拼凑借口。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: hands assembling parts into a whole, whether the parts are real or not.
core.cn: 核心意象：双手把零件拼成整体，不管零件是真是假。

branches.en: The false-invention sense is now the headline one.
branches.cn: 造假义如今是首要义项。

branches.en: The manufacturing sense stays neutral and technical.
branches.cn: 制造义保持中性、技术化。

branches.en: An excuse is a small fabricated object.
branches.cn: 借口是小型「制品」。

branches.en: Both involve assembling pieces that do not hold up.
branches.cn: 两者都是拼起经不起推敲的东西。

branches.en: The same verb serves honest and dishonest making.
branches.cn: 同一动词兼指诚实与不诚实的制作。

intro.en: Fabricate is built on the Latin workshop root fabrica.
intro.cn: fabricate 建立在拉丁语作坊词根 fabrica 上。

latinIntro.en: Latin fabrica gives fabric, fabricate, and fabrication; facere, to make, is the deeper root.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 fabrica 给出 fabric、fabricate、fabrication；更深的词根是 facere（做）。

items.meaning: the act of building or inventing

definition_zh: 把材料切割、成形并装配成构件的过程；也指捏造、伪造之事
definition_en: the process of cutting, forming and assembling materials into a structure, or the act of inventing something false
core_image: 钢板上先画线，再被等离子弧切开，边缘打磨后吊到胎架上点焊，一块构件就这样从平板变成梁
scene: 加工车间里，钢板被等离子切割机切开，边角打磨后吊到胎架上点焊成梁。Sheet-metal fabrication requires precise measurements.
sceneCN: 这里指金属板材的加工与成型过程（第 1 个义项：把材料切割、成形并装配成构件的过程）；句意：金属板材加工需要精确的测量。

derivatives.zh: 由拉丁语「工匠制作」进入英语，义为「制造；捏造」
由「制造」加已然词尾构成，义为「制造的；捏造的」
由「制造」加施动词尾构成，义为「制造者、加工商」
由拉丁语「工坊、织物」进入英语，义为「织物、结构」
由「预先」加「制造」构成，义为「预制」
由「预制」加名词词尾构成，义为「预制加工」

senses.title: Cutting and forming metal
senses.definition: the industrial process of cutting, bending and welding material into finished parts
senses.definitionCN: 把材料切割、弯折并焊接成成品构件的工业过程
senses.example: The fabrication of the frame took four days in the shop.
senses.exampleCN: 框架的加工在车间里花了四天。
senses.why: The root verb means to make by a craftsman, so the noun names the making of a built object.
senses.whyCN: 词根动词意为工匠制作，因此这个名词指把物件做出来的过程。

senses.title: Assembly of parts into a whole
senses.definition: the joining of cut parts into a single structure or machine
senses.definitionCN: 把切好的部件连接成一个结构或机器
senses.example: Fabrication and erection are separate contracts on this site.
senses.exampleCN: 在这个工地上，加工与安装是两份分开的合同。
senses.why: Making a structure needs both cutting and joining, and the word covers the joined result as well as the cutting.
senses.whyCN: 造结构既需切割也需连接，这个词既指切割，也指连接后的成品。

senses.title: Inventing a false story
senses.definition: the act of inventing facts, an account or an excuse that is not true
senses.definitionCN: 编造不真实的事实、叙述或借口
senses.example: The whole rumour was a fabrication from a single anonymous post.
senses.exampleCN: 整个谣言只是从一个匿名帖子编造出来的。
senses.why: A thing made can be made without material, so the word extends from building objects to building lies.
senses.whyCN: 造物可以不用材料，于是这个词从造物件扩展到造谎言。

senses.title: Forging a document or evidence
senses.definition: the deliberate making of a false document, record or piece of evidence
senses.definitionCN: 有意制作虚假文件、记录或证据
senses.example: The court found the letter to be a fabrication.
senses.exampleCN: 法庭认定这封信是伪造的。
senses.why: False paper is also made by a maker, so the manufacturing word serves for deliberate forgery.
senses.whyCN: 假文件同样由制作者做出，因此制造词也用于有意的伪造。

senses.title: Semiconductor manufacturing
senses.definition: the sequence of deposition, etching and patterning that turns a wafer into chips
senses.definitionCN: 把晶圆变成芯片的沉积、刻蚀与图形化流程
senses.example: Wafer fabrication needs a clean room cleaner than an operating theatre.
senses.exampleCN: 晶圆制造需要比手术室更洁净的洁净室。
senses.why: Chip making is a highly controlled kind of making, so the general word names the whole factory process.
senses.whyCN: 芯片制造是高度受控的制造，因此这个泛称指整个工厂流程。

senses.title: Steel structure work
senses.definition: the cutting, drilling and welding of steel members in a fabrication shop
senses.definitionCN: 在加工车间对钢构件进行切割、钻孔与焊接
senses.example: The bridge's fabrication was checked against the shop drawings.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥的钢结构加工对照车间图纸进行了检查。
senses.why: Steel is cut and joined away from site, and that shop work is the clearest industrial use of the word.
senses.whyCN: 钢在现场之外被切割与连接，这种车间工作是该词最清晰的工业用法。

senses.title: A made-up thing
senses.definition: a story, excuse or claim that has been invented and does not exist as described
senses.definitionCN: 被编造出来、并不如所述存在的说法、借口或主张
senses.example: His alibi was a fabrication with no supporting detail.
senses.exampleCN: 他的不在场证明是捏造的，没有任何细节支撑。
senses.why: The noun can name the false thing itself, not only the act of making it.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词可指虚假之物本身，而不只是编造的动作。

senses.title: A fabrication shop or trade
senses.definition: the workshop, business or trade that cuts and assembles material for construction
senses.definitionCN: 为建筑切割并组装材料的车间、企业或行业
senses.example: She learned welding in a small fabrication on the coast.
senses.exampleCN: 她在海边一家小型加工车间学会了焊接。
senses.why: The place where the work is done takes the name of the work, a common shift in trade words.
senses.whyCN: 干活的地方沿用工作的名称，这是行业词常见的转义。

intro.en: Fabrication comes from Latin words for a craftsman and his workshop; English first used it for making things and later for making things that are not true.
intro.cn: 「制造」来自拉丁语中表示工匠及其工坊的词；英语先用它指造物，后来也指造出不真实的东西。

items.en: Faber meant a craftsman, especially a smith or carpenter; it is the direct Latin source, while its deeper origin is uncertain and the link to a shaping root is only a suggestion.
items.cn: 这个拉丁语名词指工匠，尤指铁匠或木匠；它是本词的直接拉丁语来源，其更早来源存疑，与表示「塑造」之词根的关联仅为推测。

items.en: Fabrica named a workshop and also the craft or structure made there, and English fabric later narrowed to woven cloth.
items.cn: 这个拉丁语名词指工坊，也指在那里做出的手艺或结构；英语的「织物」后来缩小为编织布料。

items.en: Fabricare meant to make, build or shape something in a workshop, with no hint of deceit.
items.cn: 这个拉丁语动词指在工坊里制作、建造或塑造，完全没有欺骗含义。

items.era: LATIN FABRICATIO · FIRST RECORD DATE UNCERTAIN
items.en: Fabricatio named the act of making, and English fabrication kept that sense for metal, timber and stone work; the earliest English record of the borrowed noun is not precisely dated.
items.cn: 这个拉丁语名词指制作的行为，英语的「制造」保留了用于金属、木材与石材工作的含义；英语借入这一名词的最早记录年代不确定。

items.en: From the idea of building a thing comes the idea of building a story, and by the eighteenth century fabrication could mean a lie.
items.cn: 从「造物」的观念衍生出「造故事」的观念，到十八世纪，这个词已可指谎言。

items.en: Engineering kept the honest sense for cutting and welding, while semiconductor work gave it a high-technology meaning.
items.cn: 工程保留了切割与焊接的诚实义，半导体工作又给了它一个高科技含义。

note.en: The first group shares the craftsman root; the second group separates making words from falsehood words.
note.cn: 第一组共享「工匠」词根；第二组区分制造词与虚假词。

entries.definition: To make or to invent falsely; the action behind the noun.
entries.definitionCN: 制造或编造；名词背后的动作。

entries.definition: Made, or invented in order to deceive.
entries.definitionCN: 已制造的，或为欺骗而编造的。

entries.definition: A maker or a person who invents false accounts.
entries.definitionCN: 制造者，或编造虚假说法的人。

entries.definition: Woven cloth or the structure of a building; the same root, narrowed.
entries.definitionCN: 织物或建筑的结构；同词根，词义缩小。

entries.definition: Making goods on a large scale by hand or machine; it stresses volume, not a single built member.
entries.definitionCN: 大规模手工或机器制造；强调产量，而非单件构件。

entries.definition: Putting finished parts together; fabrication also cuts and forms those parts.
entries.definitionCN: 把成品零件装在一起；目标词还包含切割与成形。

entries.definition: A false document made to deceive; narrower than the falsehood sense of the target.
entries.definitionCN: 为欺骗而做的假文件；比目标词的虚假义窄。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes and real fixed terms, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分与真实固定搭配，而不是编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The root is the craftsman in his workshop, making what he is asked to make.
normal.cn: 词根是工坊里的工匠，按要求制作东西。

normal.en: The family runs fabricate, fabricated, fabricator, fabric, prefabricate.
normal.cn: 同族词包括制造、制造的、制造者、织物、预制。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark it: metal fabrication, fabrication shop, fabrication of evidence.
normal.cn: 固定搭配可标记它：金属加工、加工车间、伪造证据。

normal.en: The honest sense cuts and welds; the dishonest sense invents and forges.
normal.cn: 诚实义用于切割与焊接，不诚实义用于编造与伪造。

normal.en: Its test is material: a lie has no shop drawing.
normal.cn: 它的检验是物质性的：谎言没有车间图纸。

abstract.en: Picture a flat plate becoming a beam after one cut and one weld.
abstract.cn: 想象一块平板经过一次切割与一次焊接变成一根梁。

abstract.en: Picture a story assembled from spare parts that no supplier ever sold.
abstract.cn: 想象一个用从未有供应商卖过的零件拼成的故事。

abstract.en: Picture a signature drawn by a hand that never owned the name.
abstract.cn: 想象一个从未拥有该姓名的手画出的签名。

examples.en: Metal fabrication holds the tolerance better than site cutting.
examples.cn: 金属加工比现场切割更能保证公差。

examples.en: The report's key quotation turned out to be a fabrication.
examples.cn: 报告的关键引文结果是捏造的。

examples.en: He runs a small fabrication behind the railway yard.
examples.cn: 他在铁路场后面经营一家小型加工车间。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「工匠在工坊里做活」——既能造梁，也能造谎

root: 源自拉丁语「工匠」及其「工坊、制作」的词族；诚实义指切割焊接，虚假义指编造与伪造；工匠一词更早来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one maker: material is cut and joined, chips are patterned, and stories are invented. The same word covers honest making and deliberate falsehood.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项围绕一个制作者：材料被切割与连接，芯片被图形化，故事被编造。同一个词既覆盖诚实的制造，也覆盖有意的虚假。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a flat steel plate cut, ground and welded into a beam; the same gesture can also assemble a lie.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块平板钢被切割、打磨并焊成梁；同一个动作也能拼出一个谎言。

branches.en: THE HONEST CORE: cutting, forming and joining material into a member.
branches.cn: 诚实核心：把材料切割、成形并连接成构件。

branches.en: THE FALSEHOOD VERSION: inventing a story, and the invented thing itself.
branches.cn: 虚假版本：编造说法，以及被编造出来的东西。

branches.en: THE DOCUMENT VERSION: deliberate forgery of paper or evidence.
branches.cn: 文书版本：有意伪造文件或证据。

branches.en: THE CHIP VERSION: deposition, etching and patterning on a wafer.
branches.cn: 芯片版本：晶圆上的沉积、刻蚀与图形化。

branches.en: THE SHOP VERSION: steel structure work and the workshop that does it.
branches.cn: 车间版本：钢结构加工与从事加工的车间。

intro.en: The word is Latin: a craftsman, his workshop, the act of making there, and then a story made without material.
intro.cn: 这个词来自拉丁语：工匠、他的工坊、在那里制作的行为，以及随后不用材料造出的故事。

latinIntro.en: Latin faber, fabrica and fabricatio supply the whole family, including fabric and prefabricate.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的工匠、工坊与制作提供了整个词族，包括织物与预制。

items.example: The root of the whole family.

items.exampleCN: 它还给英语提供了「织物」。

items.example: It marks the process and the product.
The agent ending names the person or firm.
A narrowed descendant of the workshop word.
The compound keeps the honest sense only.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词只保留诚实义。

definition_zh: 极好的；绝妙的；传说中的；惊人的
definition_en: extremely good or enjoyable; belonging to legend rather than to real life
core_image: 说故事的人抬起手，听的人眼里亮起惊叹的光
scene: 朋友旅行归来，说起海边一家小馆的晚餐，语气里全是惊叹。She said the food there was absolutely fabulous.
sceneCN: 这里 fabulous 是「极好的」（第 1 个义项：好到令人惊叹）；句意：她说那里的食物好极了。

derivatives.zh: fabulous 的口语缩略，意为「极好的」

senses.title: Extremely good
senses.definition: extremely good, pleasant, or impressive
senses.definitionCN: 非常好、令人愉快或令人赞叹的
senses.example: We had a fabulous time at the wedding.
senses.exampleCN: 我们在婚礼上玩得非常开心。
senses.why: Latin fabulosus first meant famed in story, so praise for a person or an event grew out of the idea of being worth telling.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 fabulosus 最初意为「在故事里出名的」，所以对人、对事的赞美是从「值得讲进故事里」这个想法长出来的。

senses.title: Legendary
senses.definition: existing only in fables or legends and not in real life
senses.definitionCN: 只存在于寓言或传说中，现实中并不存在的
senses.example: Sailors once drew fabulous beasts in the empty corners of their maps.
senses.exampleCN: 水手们曾在航海图的空白角落画下传说中的怪兽。
senses.why: The base Latin word fabula is a story, so fabulous stayed close to the world of tales.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语本词 fabula 就是「故事」，因此 fabulous 一直贴近传说的世界。

senses.title: Astonishingly large
senses.definition: surprisingly great in amount or degree, almost beyond belief
senses.definitionCN: 在数量或程度上大得令人吃惊，几乎超出相信的范围
senses.example: The old mansion was sold for a fabulous sum.
senses.exampleCN: 那座老宅以一笔惊人的高价卖出。
senses.why: What appears in tales is larger than life, so the word can measure size as well as quality.
senses.whyCN: 故事里出现的东西总比现实夸张，所以这个词既能衡量品质，也能衡量数量。

senses.title: Hard to believe
senses.definition: so strange or unlikely that it sounds invented
senses.definitionCN: 奇怪或不大可能到听起来像是编造的
senses.example: He gave a fabulous account of how the money disappeared.
senses.exampleCN: 他对那笔钱如何消失讲了一套离奇的说法。
senses.why: Since fabula can also mean an invented tale, anything that sounds made up may be called fabulous.
senses.whyCN: 既然 fabula 也能指编造出来的故事，任何听起来像编出来的事都可以用 fabulous 形容。

intro.en: Fabulous comes from Latin fabulosus, famed in story, from fabula, a tale, and fari, to speak.
intro.cn: fabulous 来自拉丁语 fabulosus（在故事中有名的），根源是 fabula（故事）与 fari（说话）。

items.en: Fari means to speak or to tell.
items.cn: fari 意为说话、讲述。

items.en: Fabula is a story or tale that is told.
items.cn: fabula 是被讲述的故事或传说。

items.en: Fabulosus means famous in story or legendary.
items.cn: fabulosus 意为在故事中出名的、传说中的。

items.en: Fabuleux carries the word into French.
items.cn: fabuleux 把这个词带进法语。

items.en: Fabulous enters English with the sense of legendary.
items.cn: 中古英语的 fabulous 带着「传说中的」这一含义进入英语。

items.en: Modern English adds the everyday sense of extremely good.
items.cn: 现代英语又增加了「极好的」这一日常含义。

note.en: Fabulous belongs to the fabula story family, and it now competes with everyday praise words such as wonderful and marvellous.
note.cn: fabulous 属于 fabula（故事）词族，如今又与 wonderful、marvellous 这类日常赞美词并用。

entries.definition: a short story that teaches a lesson
a short informal word for fabulous
entries.definitionCN: fabulous 的缩略口语形式，意为极好的

entries.definition: in a wonderful or amazing way
extremely good
extremely good or surprising
existing only in myths

normalIntro.en: Fabulous ties praise to the language of stories: something fabulous is as good as a tale worth retelling.
normalIntro.cn: fabulous 把赞美和故事的语言连在一起：极好的东西就像值得一再讲述的故事。

normal.en: The view from the hill was fabulous.
normal.cn: 山顶的景色美极了。

normal.en: She looked fabulous in that red dress.
normal.cn: 她穿那条红裙子非常漂亮。

normal.en: We had a fabulous meal at the little restaurant.
normal.cn: 我们在这家小馆吃了一顿极好的饭。

normal.en: Fable and fabulous share the Latin word for story.
normal.cn: fable 与 fabulous 共享拉丁语中「故事」这个词。

normal.en: Compare wonderful: it is plainer, while fabulous sounds more excited.
normal.cn: 对比 wonderful：它更平实，fabulous 听起来更兴奋。

abstract.en: Picture listeners holding their breath as a storyteller describes a golden city.
abstract.cn: 想象说书人描述一座金色城市，听者屏住呼吸。

abstract.en: Imagine a map with sea monsters drawn in the empty corners.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图，空白角落画着海怪。

abstract.en: Think of a price tag with so many zeros that the crowd gasps.
abstract.cn: 想象价签上的零多到让围观的人倒吸一口气。

examples.en: The hotel staff gave us fabulous service.
examples.cn: 酒店员工给我们提供了极好的服务。

examples.en: She told a fabulous story about a city under the sea.
examples.cn: 她讲了一个关于海底之城的离奇故事。

examples.en: Fashion critics called the new collection fabulous.
examples.cn: 时尚评论家称这个新系列棒极了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「发不乐死」：高兴到「乐死」，正合「极好的」；这只是读音联想，与 fabula 的词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 fari（说话）→ fabula（故事、传说）→ fabulosus（故事中有名的、传说中的）→ 古法语 fabuleux → 英语 fabulous，核心义「像故事里一样非凡」。

sensesIntro.en: Fabulous moves from being famed in a story to being legendary, then to being astonishing in size, and finally to meaning simply excellent.
sensesIntro.cn: fabulous 从「在故事里出名」变为「传说中的」，再指「大得惊人」，最后落到「极好的」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a storyteller lifting a hand while listeners gasp.
core.cn: 核心意象：说书人抬起手，听者发出惊叹。

branches.en: Praise is the everyday sense of the word.
branches.cn: 赞美是这个词最日常的义项。

branches.en: Legend is where the word started.
branches.cn: 传说才是这个词的起点。

branches.en: Enormous size borrows the exaggeration of tales.
branches.cn: 巨大的数量借用了故事的夸张。

branches.en: A story that sounds invented gives the sense of unbelievable.
branches.cn: 听起来像编造的故事，带来「难以置信」的义项。

branches.en: Both senses describe something worth telling other people about.
branches.cn: 两个义项都形容值得讲给别人听的东西。

intro.en: Fabulous is built on the Latin story word fabula, with the adjective ending seen in fabulosus.
intro.cn: fabulous 建立在拉丁语「故事」一词 fabula 上，形容词词尾来自 fabulosus。

latinIntro.en: Latin fari, fabula, and fabulosus supply the speaking, the story, and the adjective.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 fari、fabula 与 fabulosus 分别提供「说话」「故事」与形容词形式。

items.example: Fabula is the story behind English fable.
items.exampleCN: fabula 是英语 fable 背后的「故事」。
fari 提供「说话」这一词根。

items.meaning: full of, having the quality of
items.example: The suffix -ous turns a noun into an adjective.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ous 把名词变成形容词。

items.meaning: a short story with a moral
items.example: A fable ends with a lesson.
Fabulous carries both praise and legend.
items.exampleCN: fabulous 同时带着赞美与传说。

items.example: The fabulousness of the show pleased the crowd.
items.exampleCN: 演出的精彩让观众很满意。
这位寓言作家编出了会说话的动物。

latinEntries.example: Fabula is the source of fable and fabulous.
latinEntries.exampleCN: fabula 是 fable 与 fabulous 的来源。

latinEntries.example: Fari belongs to the same story family.
latinEntries.exampleCN: fari 属于同一个「故事」词族。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 传说中的；故事中有名的

definition_zh: 建筑正面；主立面；假象；掩饰真面目的外表
definition_en: the front of a building, or a false appearance that hides what is really there
core_image: 舞台布景般的一面墙：正面光鲜整齐，墙后是裸露的砖、管线和杂物
scene: 老剧场翻修时，工人只保留临街的那面墙，墙后全部重建。The architect kept only the original façade and rebuilt everything behind it.
sceneCN: 这里指「建筑临街的正面外壳」（第 1 个义项：建筑物朝向公众的那一面）；句意为建筑师只保留原来的临街立面，墙后全部重建。可辨识物件：旧墙、脚手架、裸露的砖、新钢梁。

pos.zh: （比喻）假象；掩饰真面目的外表

derivatives.zh: 立面主义：只保住建筑正面外墙、其后全部翻新的做法（由基础词加表示「以某物为宗旨」的后缀构成，语义收窄为一种做法）
保留立面式改建：留下旧立面、其后掏空重建（由基础词加借自外科「切除」义的后缀构成，语义偏移为「只留外壳」）
像建筑正面的；只有表面一层的（由基础词加表示「像……的」后缀构成，语义偏移为性质描述）
立面地役权：以合约长期保护历史建筑外墙的法律工具（由基础词与表示「地役权」的词复合，语义偏移为保护性权利）

senses.title: Front face of a building
senses.titleCN: 建筑正面：朝向街道的那一面
senses.definition: the front wall of a building, especially the side that faces a street or public space
senses.definitionCN: 建筑物的正面外墙，尤指朝向街道或公共空间的一面
senses.example: The shop's façade was repainted in deep green.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店铺的正面外墙被重新漆成深绿色。
senses.why: The word came into English from French for 'face'. A building's public face is literally the side it turns toward the street.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从法语进入英语，本义就是「脸」。建筑面向街道的那一侧，正像它的一张脸。

senses.title: Principal designed elevation
senses.titleCN: 主立面：经过专门设计的那一面
senses.definition: the main side of a building when that side is treated as a designed architectural surface
senses.definitionCN: 把某一面墙当作经过设计的建筑表面来处理时，指主立面
senses.example: The museum's façade is a grid of pale stone and glass.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆的主立面是一片浅色石材与玻璃构成的网格。
senses.why: Architects use the word for the elevation that carries the design, not merely for any outer wall. The face becomes a composition.
senses.whyCN: 建筑师用这个词指承载设计意图的那个立面，而不只是任意一堵外墙。脸因此变成一幅构图。

senses.title: False appearance
senses.titleCN: 假象：做给外人看的外表
senses.definition: a false or artificial appearance that hides the true state of something
senses.definitionCN: 掩盖真实情况的虚假或人为外表
senses.example: The company maintained a façade of prosperity while its debts grew.
senses.exampleCN: 公司维持着繁荣的假象，债务却在不断增加。
senses.why: If the front of a building can hide what is behind it, then any polished outward show can hide a messy reality. The architectural image becomes a metaphor for deception.
senses.whyCN: 既然建筑的正面能遮住墙后的东西，任何光鲜的对外展示也就能遮住混乱的真实。建筑意象由此变成欺骗的隐喻。

senses.title: Outward composure of a person
senses.definition: the outward manner a person presents to others, often hiding inner distress
senses.definitionCN: 一个人呈现给别人的外在举止，常掩盖内心的痛苦
senses.example: She kept up a cheerful façade long after the loss.
senses.exampleCN: 失去之后很久，她仍维持着快活的外表。
senses.why: A person also has a public front. The word names the face worn in company, especially when the private self does not match it.
senses.whyCN: 人也有对外的正面。这个词指在众人面前戴着的那张脸，尤其当私下的自己与它并不一致时。

senses.title: Front for an illegal activity
senses.titleCN: 掩护门面：为非法活动打掩护的场所
senses.definition: an organization or business that exists mainly to conceal another, usually illegal, activity
senses.definitionCN: 主要为掩盖另一项（通常非法的）活动而存在的机构或生意
senses.example: The restaurant was a façade for a smuggling operation.
senses.exampleCN: 这家餐馆是一个走私活动的掩护门面。
senses.why: The sense extends the building image: a respectable front room is shown to the public while the real business happens out of sight.
senses.whyCN: 这一义项延伸了建筑意象：给公众看的是体面的门面，真正的生意却在看不见的地方进行。

senses.title: Visible face of an institution
senses.definition: the public image an institution presents, as distinct from its internal workings
senses.definitionCN: 机构对外呈现的公众形象，与内部运作相区别
senses.example: The committee is the public façade of a much larger network.
senses.exampleCN: 这个委员会是一个庞大网络的对外门面。
senses.why: Institutions, like buildings, are judged by what meets the eye. The word separates that visible front from the structure behind it.
senses.whyCN: 机构像建筑一样，先由看得见的部分被评判。这个词把这道可见的正面与其后的结构区分开。

senses.title: Simplified interface of a software system
senses.definition: in software design, a single simplified interface that hides a set of more complex subsystems
senses.definitionCN: 软件设计中，用一个简化的统一接口遮住背后的一组复杂子系统
senses.example: The library offers a small façade over dozens of internal services.
senses.exampleCN: 这个程序库在数十个内部服务之上提供了一个小型门面接口。
senses.why: Programmers borrowed the architectural word because their pattern does the same job: one clean front hides many moving parts.
senses.whyCN: 程序员借用这个建筑词，因为这种设计模式做的是同一件事：一张干净的门面遮住许多运转的部件。

senses.title: Polished surface hiding disorder
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：光洁表面掩盖内在混乱
senses.definition: any smooth, orderly surface that conceals confusion, conflict or decay underneath
senses.definitionCN: 任何光滑有序、掩盖其下混乱、冲突或衰败的表面
senses.example: The report presented a façade of order over a department in crisis.
senses.exampleCN: 报告给一个陷入危机的部门套上了秩序的外表。
senses.why: The general sense gathers the building, the person and the institution: whatever is shown is intact, whatever is hidden is not.
senses.whyCN: 这个一般义把建筑、个人与机构三条线收在一起：展示出来的部分完好，藏起来的部分则不然。

senses.title: Preserved front of a historic building
senses.titleCN: 历史建筑被保留的正面
senses.definition: the original front wall of a historic building, kept standing while the rest is altered or rebuilt
senses.definitionCN: 历史建筑原有的正面外墙，在其余部分被改造或重建时仍保留下来
senses.example: Preservation rules protected the façade but allowed a new tower behind.
senses.exampleCN: 保护规定保住了这面旧立面，却允许在其后建一座新塔楼。
senses.why: This sense joins the physical front to the idea of display: the wall is kept because it is the part the city remembers.
senses.whyCN: 这一义项把实体正面与「展示」的观念接上：墙之所以被保留，是因为它是城市记得的那一部分。

intro.en: Façade came into English from French in the seventeenth century. French took the word from Italian, and Italian built it on the Latin word for 'face'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: façade 于十七世纪从法语进入英语。法语这个词借自意大利语，意大利语则用拉丁语中表示「脸」的词构成。年代均为约数。

items.en: Latin facies meant 'form, shape, appearance, face'. Its deeper origin is source uncertain; a link to facere 'to make' is generally believed by some references but not demonstrated.
items.cn: 拉丁语 facies 意为「形状、外观、脸」。其更深来源属「来源不确定」；有资料认为它与 facere「制作」有关，但这只是「一般认为是」，并未得到证明。

items.en: Italian built facciata 'front of a building' from faccia 'face'. The suffix marked a collective surface rather than a single face.
items.cn: 意大利语用 faccia「脸」构成 facciata「建筑正面」。后缀使这个词指一整片表面，而不是一张具体的脸。

items.en: French reshaped the Italian word into façade, and English borrowed it in the seventeenth century for the front of a large building.
items.cn: 法语把意大利语词改造成 façade，英语在十七世纪借来，指大型建筑的正面。

items.en: For two centuries the word stayed technical: the principal elevation of a palace, church or public building.
items.cn: 此后两个世纪，这个词一直偏技术：宫殿、教堂或公共建筑的主立面。

items.en: By the nineteenth century the metaphor of a front that hides what lies behind produced the sense of a false or superficial appearance.
items.cn: 到十九世纪，正面遮住其后之物的比喻催生了「虚假、表面的外观」这一义项。

items.en: Source uncertain: the pre-Latin origin of facies is unsettled, and any older Indo-European form offered for it is a reconstructed form rather than a recorded word.
items.cn: 来源不确定：facies 在拉丁语之前的来源没有定论，凡为其给出的更早印欧语形式都属于重构形式，而非有记录的真实词形。

note.en: Group one holds forms that look or sound close but come from different roots; group two holds words for the same visible front.
note.cn: 第一组是形近或音近、但词根不同的词；第二组是同样表示「看得见的正面」的词。

entries.definition: the front of the head; also an outer surface. It descends from Latin facies through Old French, so it is a doublet of façade rather than a word built from it.
entries.definitionCN: 头部正面；也指外表面。它经古法语来自拉丁 facies，与 façade 是同源异形词，而不是由 façade 派生出来的词。

entries.definition: one flat cut surface of a gem or an aspect of a subject. It comes from French facette, a diminutive of face, so it belongs to the same family.
entries.definitionCN: 宝石的一个平面；也指问题的一个方面。它来自法语 facette，是 face 的指小形式，属于同一词族。

entries.definition: a band of tissue, or a flat board covering a beam. It comes from Latin fascia 'band', a different root, although the spelling is close.
entries.definitionCN: 筋膜；覆盖梁的平板。它来自拉丁 fascia「带子」，词根不同，只是拼写相近。

entries.definition: the most general word for the side that faces forward; it carries no artistic or deceptive overtone.
entries.definitionCN: 最普通的说法，泛指朝前的一面；不含艺术设计或欺骗的意味。

entries.definition: the outside of a building or object as a whole, not specifically the designed public face.
entries.definitionCN: 建筑或物体整体的外部，不特指经过设计的对外正面。

entries.definition: a thin layer of fine material glued over a cheaper surface; figuratively, a polished cover over something poor.
entries.definitionCN: 贴在廉价表面上的薄层好材料；比喻义指覆盖在劣质事物上的光鲜表层。

entries.definition: something worn or put on to hide a face or a feeling; it stresses deliberate concealment more than façade does.
entries.definitionCN: 戴在脸上或用来掩盖情绪之物；比 façade 更强调刻意的遮掩。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The word is the same 'face' idea as in facial: a building's face turned toward the street.
normal.cn: 这个词与 facial 中的「脸」是同一个观念：建筑朝向街道的那张脸。

normal.en: The fixed phrase behind the façade marks the shift from stone to secrecy.
normal.cn: 固定搭配「在表象背后」标出了从石头到隐秘的语义转移。

normal.en: Facadism names the practice of keeping only that face while the body is replaced.
normal.cn: 「立面主义」指只留下这张脸、把身体整个换掉的做法。

normal.en: Architects speak of the principal elevation when they mean the designed front.
normal.cn: 建筑师说「主立面」时，指的正是经过设计的正面。

normal.en: Software calls a simplified interface a façade because it, too, is one clean front over many parts.
normal.cn: 软件把简化接口叫作门面，因为它同样是一张干净正面遮住许多部件。

abstract.en: Picture a stage set: painted walls in front, bare scaffolding behind.
abstract.cn: 想象一套舞台布景：前面是画好的墙，后面是裸露的脚手架。

abstract.en: Picture a person holding a smile steady while the hands tremble.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人稳稳挂着微笑，双手却在发抖。

abstract.en: Picture a tidy shop window with an empty room behind the glass.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇整洁的橱窗，玻璃后面却是一间空屋。

examples.en: The facade was measured in the lab. The old bank kept its stone façade but rebuilt the interior as flats.
examples.cn: 那家老银行保留了石砌立面，却把内部改建成公寓。

examples.en: Behind a façade of calm, the negotiators were close to walking out.
examples.cn: 在镇定的表象背后，谈判者们几乎要退场了。

examples.en: The charity was accused of acting as a façade for a political group.
examples.cn: 该慈善机构被指为一个政治团体充当掩护门面。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「发萨德」—— 发出一张萨德式的门面，门后却空着 → 建筑正面、假象

root: 法语 façade 借自意大利语 facciata，源头是拉丁 facies「形状、外观、脸」；与英语 face 同源而非派生。facies 在拉丁语之前的来源不确定，更早的印欧语形式均属重构。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses follow one object: a building turns a single face toward the public. That face becomes a designed composition, then a false front for a person, a business or an institution, and finally a clean surface laid over any disorder.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项围绕同一个对象展开：建筑把一张脸转向公众。这张脸先是设计过的构图，再成为个人、生意或机构的虚假正面，最后成为铺在任何混乱之上的一层光洁表面。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one polished wall faces the street while everything unfinished stays behind it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一堵光洁的墙朝向街道，所有未完成的东西都留在墙后。

branches.en: THE FACE ITSELF: the word begins as the side a building turns toward the street.
branches.cn: 脸本身：这个词最初只指建筑转向街道的那一面。

branches.en: FACE AS ART AND MEMORY: the designed elevation and the preserved front are the same wall seen as art and as heritage.
branches.cn: 脸作为艺术与记忆：精心设计的立面与被保留的旧立面，是同一堵墙在艺术与遗产两个角度下的样子。

branches.en: FALSE FACE: a person or a company can wear a front the way a building does.
branches.cn: 假脸：个人或公司可以像建筑一样戴上一张正面。

branches.en: ORGANIZED COVER: a business or committee becomes the respectable front of something hidden.
branches.cn: 有组织的掩护：一门生意或一个委员会成为隐藏之物的体面正面。

branches.en: CLEAN SURFACE OVER COMPLEXITY: software and abstract order both use one smooth face to hide many parts.
branches.cn: 复杂度上的光洁表面：软件与抽象的秩序都用一个光滑正面遮住许多部件。

intro.en: Façade belongs to a Latin family built on facies 'form, face'. The same stock also gives the everyday word for a face, the word for a cut surface, and several verbs about removing or covering a surface.
intro.cn: façade 属于以拉丁 facies「形状、脸」为核心的一族词。同一词干还给出表示「脸」的日常词、表示「切面」的词，以及若干表示「去掉表面」或「覆盖表面」的动词。

latinIntro.en: Latin facies and its relatives passed through French into English; the family includes face, facet, facial, surface and deface.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 facies 及其同族词经法语进入英语；这一族包括表示脸、切面、面部的词，以及表示表面与毁容的词。

items.example: The root carries the idea of a visible form.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根带着「可见形状」的意思。

items.example: The Latin noun is the source of the whole family.
items.exampleCN: 这个拉丁名词是整个词族的源头。

items.example: The theatre's façade faces the square.

items.meaning: the front of the head; an outer surface
items.exampleCN: 她的脸没有透露任何东西。

items.meaning: a cut surface of a gem; an aspect
items.example: Each facet of the diamond caught the light.
items.exampleCN: 钻石的每个切面都反着光。
这家水疗馆提供面部护理。

items.example: The surface of the lake was still.

items.meaning: to spoil the surface of something
preserving only the front wall of a building
items.meaningCN: 只保留建筑正面的做法
items.example: Facadism saved the outline but not the rooms.
items.exampleCN: 立面主义保住了轮廓，却没保住房间。

items.meaning: rebuilding everything behind a kept front wall
items.meaningCN: 保留旧立面、其后全部重建
items.example: The facadectomy left a hollow shell for one season.
items.exampleCN: 这项立面保留工程让建筑空了一季。

items.meaning: resembling a building front; merely surface

definition_zh: 脸；表面；面对；面临
definition_en: the front of the head; the front surface of something; to turn toward something; to deal with a difficulty
core_image: 一张正对镜头的脸，背后是必须直面的墙
scene: 她面对困难从不退缩。She never backs away when she faces difficulty.
sceneCN: 这里 face 是「面对、面临」（第 3 个义项）；句意：她面对困难从不退缩。

senses.title: The front of the head
senses.definition: the front part of the head where the eyes, nose, and mouth are
senses.definitionCN: 头部前面长有眼睛、鼻子和嘴的部位
senses.example: She washed her face with cold water.
senses.exampleCN: 她用冷水洗脸。
senses.why: The core sense is the front of the head.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是头部的前面。

senses.title: The front surface
senses.definition: the front or outer surface of an object
senses.definitionCN: 物体的前面或外表面
senses.example: The face of the clock is cracked.
senses.exampleCN: 钟面裂了。
senses.why: The front of the head names the front of things.
senses.whyCN: 头部的前面被用来命名物体的正面。

senses.title: Turn toward
senses.definition: to turn or point toward someone or something
senses.definitionCN: 转向或朝向某人某物
senses.example: The house faces the sea.
senses.exampleCN: 这栋房子面朝大海。
senses.why: The front becomes the direction one turns.
senses.whyCN: 正面变成所朝的方向。

senses.title: Deal with difficulty
senses.definition: to have to deal with a difficult situation
senses.definitionCN: 不得不应对困难处境
senses.example: The company faces rising costs.
senses.exampleCN: 公司面临成本上升。
senses.why: Facing a person becomes facing a problem.
senses.whyCN: 面对一个人变成面对一个问题。

intro.en: Face comes from Latin facies, form or appearance, through Old French face.
intro.cn: face 经古法语 face 来自拉丁语 facies，意为形状或外观。

items.en: Facies means form, shape, or appearance.
items.cn: facies 意为形状、外形或外观。

items.en: The word covers both a face and a surface.
items.cn: 这个词兼指面孔与表面。

items.en: Face keeps the sense of front and look.
items.cn: 古法语 face 保留「正面与外观」之义。

items.en: Face becomes the common word for the front of the head.
items.cn: 中古英语中 face 成为表示面孔的常用词。

items.en: Face also means to confront a problem.
items.cn: 现代英语中 face 也指面对问题。

note.en: Face is the front; fact is something true.
note.cn: face 是正面，fact 则是事实。

entries.definition: something that is true
what is destined to happen
to become less bright
to face a problem directly
the forward part of something
the outer or top layer

normalIntro.en: Face moves from the front of the head to the front of things and to facing trouble.
normalIntro.cn: face 从头部正面扩展到物体正面，再到面对困难。

normal.en: She has a kind face.
normal.cn: 她有一张和善的脸。

normal.en: The north face of the mountain is cold.
normal.cn: 山的北面很冷。

normal.en: We sat face to face across the table.
normal.cn: 我们隔着桌子面对面坐着。

normal.en: The team faces a serious problem.
normal.cn: 团队面临一个严重问题。

normal.en: He made a face at the bitter medicine.
normal.cn: 他对着苦药做了个鬼脸。

abstract.en: Picture a face looking straight into a mirror.
abstract.cn: 想象一张正对镜子的脸。

abstract.en: Imagine a wall that stands against the wind.
abstract.cn: 想象一面迎着风的墙。

abstract.en: Think of a person stepping toward a hard task.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人迈向艰难任务。

examples.en: The building faces the main square.
examples.cn: 这栋建筑面向主广场。

examples.en: We must face the facts honestly.
examples.cn: 我们必须诚实面对事实。

examples.en: Her face showed no fear.
examples.cn: 她脸上没有露出恐惧。

root: 源自拉丁语 facies（形状、外观），经古法语 face 进入英语，核心义「正面、面孔」及「正面对待」。

sensesIntro.en: Face means the front of the head, the front surface, to turn toward, or to deal with difficulty.
sensesIntro.cn: face 意为头部正面、物体表面、朝向，或面对困难。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a face turned straight toward the viewer.
core.cn: 核心意象：正对观看者的一张脸。

branches.en: The base sense is the front of the head.
branches.cn: 基础义是头部的前面。

branches.en: The head's front names the front of objects.
branches.cn: 头部正面被用来命名物体正面。

branches.en: The front becomes the direction one turns.
branches.cn: 正面变成所朝的方向。

branches.en: Facing a person becomes facing a problem.
branches.cn: 面对一个人变成面对一个问题。

branches.en: Turning toward a thing and confronting it share one motion.
branches.cn: 朝向某物与直面某物共享同一动作。

intro.en: Face comes from Latin facies and builds facial, facing, and faceless.
intro.cn: face 来自拉丁语 facies，并构成 facial、facing 与 faceless。

latinIntro.en: Latin facies and facere are related source forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 facies 与 facere 是相关的来源形式。

items.meaning: front of the head or to confront
more than one face or confronts
items.meaningCN: 面孔（复数）；面对（第三人称）

items.example: The room facing the sea is bright.
items.exampleCN: 面朝大海的房间很明亮。
看不清面孔的人群继续前行。
他们举行了面对面的会议。

definition_zh: 面部的；脸的；面部护理
definition_en: relating to the face; a beauty treatment that cleans and massages the face
core_image: 镜子前，两只手捧住脸颊，指尖沿着轮廓慢慢移动
scene: 她对着镜子摸了摸自己的脸颊，觉得皮肤有点干。She booked a facial at the salon before the wedding.
sceneCN: 这里 facial 是「面部护理」（第 3 个义项：美容院里的面部保养）；句意：婚礼前她在美容院预约了一次面部护理。

pos.zh: 面部护理；美容院的脸部保养

senses.title: Of the face
senses.definition: relating to the face
senses.definitionCN: 与脸有关的
senses.example: Her facial expression showed no emotion.
senses.exampleCN: 她的面部表情没有流露任何情绪。
senses.why: Latin facies means the form or face of a person, so the adjective marks whatever belongs to it.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 facies 意为人的外形或脸，所以这个形容词用来标记属于脸的事物。

senses.title: Of the anatomy of the face
senses.definition: relating to the nerves, bones, or muscles of the face
senses.definitionCN: 与脸部的神经、骨骼或肌肉有关的
senses.example: The surgeon treated a damaged facial nerve.
senses.exampleCN: 外科医生治疗了一条受损的面部神经。
senses.why: Medical Latin facialis named the structures of the face, and English kept that technical use.
senses.whyCN: 医学拉丁语 facialis 专门命名脸部的结构，英语保留了这一技术用法。

senses.title: A beauty treatment
senses.definition: a treatment in which the skin of the face is cleaned, massaged, and cared for
senses.definitionCN: 对脸部皮肤进行清洁、按摩与保养的护理
senses.example: She treats herself to a facial every month.
senses.exampleCN: 她每个月都犒赏自己做一次面部护理。
senses.why: The adjective turns into a noun for the care given to the face.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词转作名词，指专门给脸做的保养。

senses.title: A product for the face
senses.definition: a cream or wash made for the skin of the face
senses.definitionCN: 专为脸部皮肤制成的面霜或洁面品
senses.example: This facial wash is gentle enough for daily use.
senses.exampleCN: 这款洗面奶温和得可以每天使用。
senses.why: Products are named by the part they serve, so the adjective also names goods made for the face.
senses.whyCN: 产品按它服务的部位命名，所以这个形容词也用来指专为脸做的商品。

intro.en: Facial comes from Latin facies, form or face, through Medieval Latin facialis.
intro.cn: facial 来自拉丁语 facies（外形、脸），经中世纪拉丁语 facialis 进入英语。

items.en: Facies means form, shape, or face.
items.cn: facies 意为外形、形状或脸。

items.en: The face is the form a person shows to the world.
items.cn: 脸是一个人呈现给世界的外形。

items.en: Facialis means belonging to the face.
items.cn: facialis 意为属于脸的。

items.en: Facial enters English as an adjective of anatomy.
items.cn: facial 在十七世纪作为解剖学形容词进入英语。

items.en: The noun facial names a beauty treatment.
items.cn: 现代英语中名词 facial 指美容院的面部护理。

note.en: Facial sits in the Latin facies family with face and facies, and it is close to words for the look of a face.
note.cn: facial 与 face、facies 同属拉丁语 facies 词族，也与描述面部容貌的词相邻。

the face or the general appearance of a person

normalIntro.cn: facial 本义就是「脸的」，作名词时指给脸做的护理。

normal.en: A facial expression can say more than words.
normal.cn: 面部表情能比言语表达更多。

normal.en: The machine reads facial features to unlock the door.
normal.cn: 这台机器读取面部特征来开门。

normal.en: She booked a facial before the party.
normal.cn: 派对前她预约了面部护理。

normal.en: Facial skin needs gentle care in winter.
normal.cn: 冬天面部皮肤需要温和护理。

normal.en: Compare face: face is the noun, and facial is the adjective built from it.

abstract.en: Picture a finger tracing the outline of a cheek.
abstract.cn: 想象一根手指沿着脸颊的轮廓轻轻描过。

examples.en: The study looks at how facial expressions are read.
examples.cn: 这项研究考察人们如何解读面部表情。

examples.en: She had a facial the day before the wedding.

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two hands framing a face in a mirror.

branches.en: The general adjective sense comes straight from the noun face.
branches.cn: 一般的形容词义直接来自名词「脸」。

branches.en: Medical use names the structures inside the face.

branches.en: Products are also named by the part they serve.

latinIntro.en: Latin facies means form or face, and Medieval Latin facialis means of the face.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 facies 意为外形或脸，中世纪拉丁语 facialis 意为「属于脸的」。

definition_zh: 促进；使便利；便利（某事发生）；主持引导（讨论）
definition_en: to make an action, a process or a discussion easier to carry out
core_image: 原本堵在门口的杂物被搬开，队伍不必再侧身挤过，一步就进了门
scene: 主持人把话筒递给一直沉默的成员，让讨论得以继续。The chair facilitated the discussion by inviting the quiet members to speak.
sceneCN: 这里指主持人引导讨论、使交流顺畅进行（第 2 个义项：以主持人的身份引导讨论或会议）；句意：主持人请沉默的成员发言，使讨论得以推进。

senses.title: To make an action easier
senses.definition: to remove an obstacle so that something can be done with less effort
senses.definitionCN: 移除障碍，使某件事做起来更省力
senses.example: Better signs facilitate the flow of visitors through the museum.
senses.exampleCN: 更清楚的指示牌使参观者在馆内的流动更顺畅。
senses.why: The Latin adjective inside the word means easy, so the verb means to make easy.
senses.whyCN: 这个词里的拉丁形容词意为容易，因此动词意为使容易。

senses.title: To guide a discussion or meeting
senses.definition: to run a discussion so that participants can speak and decide without being directed
senses.definitionCN: 主持讨论，使参与者能够发言并作出决定，而不被强加方向
senses.example: The chair facilitated the discussion by inviting the quiet members to speak.
senses.exampleCN: 主持人请沉默的成员发言，使讨论得以推进。
senses.why: A chair is there to make talk possible, and the modern meeting sense is the plain literal one.
senses.whyCN: 主持人存在的意义就是让谈话成为可能，现代会议义其实就是最字面的用法。

senses.title: To create conditions for growth
senses.definition: to provide the circumstances in which a process can develop well
senses.definitionCN: 提供某种过程得以良好发展的环境条件
senses.example: Warm water and sunlight facilitate the growth of algae.
senses.exampleCN: 温暖的水与阳光促进藻类生长。
senses.why: Growth cannot be commanded, but the conditions for it can be made easy to reach.
senses.whyCN: 生长无法被命令，但生长所需的条件可以被弄得容易达到。

senses.title: To help communication between parties
senses.definition: to make it easier for two parties to exchange information or reach agreement
senses.definitionCN: 使两方更容易交换信息或达成一致
senses.example: A neutral adviser facilitated the talks between the two sides.
senses.exampleCN: 一位中立的顾问促成了双方的会谈。
senses.why: When two parties cannot hear each other, someone can remove the obstacle between them.
senses.whyCN: 当双方听不见彼此，总有人可以搬走横在中间的障碍。

senses.title: Of a biological process helped along
senses.definition: in biology, to assist a process that would otherwise be slow or blocked, as in facilitated diffusion
senses.definitionCN: 在生物学中，指帮助原本缓慢或受阻的过程，如易化扩散
senses.example: The channel proteins facilitate the movement of ions across the membrane.
senses.exampleCN: 通道蛋白促进离子跨膜移动。
senses.why: Cells have helpers that lower the barrier for a molecule, which is the same picture on a tiny scale.
senses.whyCN: 细胞有帮忙者，为分子降低门槛，这是同一幅画在极小尺度上的版本。

senses.title: To ease the spread of something
senses.definition: to make the spread of information, goods or a problem easier, often without endorsing it
senses.definitionCN: 使信息、货物或某个问题更容易扩散，通常并不表示赞成
senses.example: Fast networks facilitate the spread of both news and falsehood.
senses.exampleCN: 高速网络既便利新闻传播，也便利虚假信息传播。
senses.why: The verb is neutral about what spreads: it only reports that the path is easier.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词对扩散内容保持中立，只报告路径变容易了。

senses.title: To provide access
senses.definition: to make something reachable by removing practical barriers
senses.definitionCN: 移除实际障碍，使某物更容易获得
senses.example: The ramp facilitates access to the building for wheelchair users.
senses.exampleCN: 坡道使轮椅使用者更容易进入这栋建筑。
senses.why: Access is an obstacle course, and anything that removes a step is facilitating it.
senses.whyCN: 获取本身就是一道障碍赛，任何减少一步的东西都在促进它。

senses.title: To make learning easier
senses.definition: in teaching, to arrange material and tasks so that learners can progress with less friction
senses.definitionCN: 在教学中，安排材料与任务，使学习者遇到的阻力更小
senses.example: Clear examples facilitate learning more than long explanations.
senses.exampleCN: 清楚的例子比长篇解释更能促进学习。
senses.why: Teaching is largely the art of removing obstacles, which is why this verb appears in every method book.
senses.whyCN: 教学很大程度上就是移除障碍的手艺，因此这个动词出现在每一本教学法著作里。

intro.en: Facilitate comes from a Latin adjective meaning easy, which itself came from the verb for doing or making. French turned it into a verb, and English borrowed it in the sixteenth century.
intro.cn: 本词出自一个意为容易的拉丁形容词，那个形容词又来自表示做、造的动词。法语把它变成动词，英语在十六世纪借入。

items.en: Facere meant to do or to make, and it stands behind a very large English family of verbs and nouns.
items.cn: 这个拉丁动词意为做、造，英语中一大群动词与名词都出自它。

items.en: Facilis meant easy to do, and it also described a person who is easy to deal with.
items.cn: 这个拉丁形容词意为容易做，也形容一个人好相处。

items.en: French made a verb from the adjective, meaning to make easy or to help along.
items.cn: 法语由这个形容词造出动词，意为使容易、予以便利。

items.en: English borrowed the verb in the sixteenth century, first for making a task less difficult.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪借入，先用于使任务不那么困难。

items.en: Modern management and education gave it the specialized sense of guiding a discussion or a class.
items.cn: 现代管理与教育给了它引导讨论或课堂的专门含义。

note.en: The first group shares the easy root or its English family; the second group names nearby kinds of helping. Facilitate removes an obstacle, while counteract cancels an effect, so helping and opposing are separate acts.
note.cn: 第一组共享「容易」词根或其英语词族；第二组是相邻的帮忙方式。本词移除障碍，对抗类词取消效应，帮忙与对抗是两种不同的动作。

entries.definition: The act of making something easier or of guiding a group.
entries.definitionCN: 使某事更容易或引导一个群体的动作。

entries.definition: The person who removes obstacles or guides a discussion.
entries.definitionCN: 移除障碍或引导讨论的人。

entries.definition: A building or a service, and also ease in doing something.
entries.definitionCN: 建筑或服务设施，也指做事的便利。

entries.definition: Too easy, and therefore shallow; the negative side of the same root.
entries.definitionCN: 过于容易因而浅薄；同一词根的负面一面。

entries.definition: To congratulate; it looks close but comes from a word for happiness.
entries.definitionCN: 祝贺；字形相近，却出自表示幸福的词。

entries.definition: To make less painful or less difficult; it is the plain verb behind the formal one.
entries.definitionCN: 使少些痛苦或少些困难；是正式词背后的平实动词。

entries.definition: To make something possible; possibility is the point, not effort.
entries.definitionCN: 使成为可能；重点在可能性，而非费力程度。

entries.definition: To help a person or a process; it may add direct effort.
entries.definitionCN: 帮助一个人或一个过程；可能加入直接的努力。

entries.definition: To speed something up; it is about time rather than ease.
entries.definitionCN: 加快某事；关注时间，而非省力。

entries.definition: To encourage growth or acceptance; it carries a positive attitude that this word lacks.
entries.definitionCN: 鼓励增长或接受；带有本词所缺的正面态度。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the easy root, the real family and the objects that show what is being made easier.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用「容易」词根、真实同族词，以及能显示被便利之事的宾语。

normal.en: The adjective inside means easy, so the verb means to make easy.
normal.cn: 里面的形容词意为容易，动词就是使容易。

normal.en: The family runs facilitation, facilitator, facility and the adjective facile.
normal.cn: 同族词有促进、引导者、设施，以及形容词轻易的。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark it: facilitate communication, facilitate access, facilitate learning.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出用法：促进沟通、便利获取、促进学习。

normal.en: The meeting sense is literal: a chair exists to make talk possible.
normal.cn: 会议义最字面：主持人的存在就是让谈话成为可能。

normal.en: The verb is neutral about the content: good news and false news can both be helped along.
normal.cn: 这个动词对内容中立：好消息与假消息都能被便利传播。

abstract.en: Picture clutter moved away from a doorway so that people walk straight through.
abstract.cn: 想象堵在门口的杂物被搬开，人们径直走过。

abstract.en: Picture oil poured on a stuck hinge until the door swings freely.
abstract.cn: 想象给卡住的铰链上油，门便自由转动。

abstract.en: Picture a guide who opens one gate after another without walking the path for you.
abstract.cn: 想象一位向导打开一道道门，却不替你走路。

examples.en: The new software facilitates collaboration across teams.
examples.cn: 这款新软件促进了跨团队协作。

examples.en: She facilitated the workshop without offering her own answers.
examples.cn: 她主持了这次研讨，却不抛出自己的答案。

examples.en: Warm water facilitates the chemical reaction.
examples.cn: 温水促进了这一化学反应。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「法西里」加「泰特」——把门槛搬走，事情一步就过去了：使便利、促进

root: 拉丁语「做、造」动词衍生出「容易」的形容词，法语据此造出「使容易」的动词，十六世纪进入英语；现代管理与教育扩展为引导讨论。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all remove friction: a task, a discussion, a growth condition, a negotiation, a biological process, a spread, an access route and a lesson.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都在减少摩擦：任务、讨论、成长条件、谈判、生理过程、扩散、获取路径与一堂课。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: clutter pulled away from a doorway so that a queue no longer has to squeeze through sideways.
core.cn: 核心意象：原本堵在门口的杂物被搬开，队伍不必再侧身挤过，一步就进了门。

branches.en: THE PATH: a task made easier, and access opened by a ramp.
branches.cn: 路径：被弄得更容易的任务，以及用坡道打开的获取通道。

branches.en: THE TALK: a meeting guided, and communication helped between parties.
branches.cn: 谈话：被引导的会议，以及被协助的双方沟通。

branches.en: THE PROCESS: conditions arranged for growth, and a biological step helped along.
branches.cn: 过程：为成长安排的条件，以及被帮助的生理步骤。

branches.en: THE SPREAD: news, goods or falsehood moving faster through an easier channel.
branches.cn: 扩散：新闻、货物或虚假信息沿更顺畅的通道移动得更快。

branches.en: THE LESSON: material arranged so that learning meets less resistance.
branches.cn: 课堂：把材料安排好，使学习遇到的阻力更小。

intro.en: Facilitate is a Latin adjective turned into a verb by French, and its family supplies the process, the person and the ambiguous noun for ease or a building.
intro.cn: 本词是由法语把一个拉丁形容词变成动词的产物，其词族提供过程、人，以及兼指便利与建筑的歧义名词。

latinIntro.en: Latin facere and facilis supply the core, and French added the verb-forming ending.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语中表示做与容易的两个词提供核心，法语加上动词词尾。

items.example: The root supplies the act of making.
The adjective supplies the whole meaning of ease.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词提供全部的「容易」含义。

items.example: French added the verb shape English borrowed.
items.exampleCN: 法语加上英语所借入的动词外形。

items.example: It fits the borrowed stem into English conjugation.
items.exampleCN: 它把借来的词干纳入英语变位。

items.example: It builds the name of the process.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示过程的名称。

items.example: It builds the name of the person who guides.
It builds the adjective for what promotes a process.
items.exampleCN: 它构成描述促进过程之物的形容词。

items.example: It builds the noun for ease, which also names buildings.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示便利的名词，也指建筑。

items.example: It builds the adjective with the negative sense of too easy.
items.exampleCN: 它构成带「过于容易」负面义的形容词。

derivatives.zh: 同根兄弟名词，义为「设施、便利」，并非由本词派生
同根兄弟形容词，义为「轻易的、肤浅的」，并非由本词派生

definition_zh: 设施；设备；能力；便利
definition_en: a place or piece of equipment built for a purpose; an ability to do something easily; the quality of being easy to do
core_image: 一个让事情做起来更省力的装置或场所
scene: 这所学校有现代化的体育设施。The school has modern sports facilities.
sceneCN: 这里 facility 是「设施、设备」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这所学校有现代化的体育设施。

senses.title: A built place or equipment
senses.definition: a place, building, or piece of equipment built for a particular purpose
senses.definitionCN: 为特定目的建造的场所、建筑或设备
senses.example: The hotel has excellent sports facilities.
senses.exampleCN: 这家酒店有极好的体育设施。
senses.why: The core sense is something made to make an activity possible.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是为使某项活动成为可能而建造的东西。

senses.title: An easy ability
senses.definition: a natural or learned ability to do something easily
senses.definitionCN: 轻松做某事的天生或习得能力
senses.example: She has a facility for learning languages.
senses.exampleCN: 她有学习语言的天赋。
senses.why: The made thing becomes a mental tool that makes action easy.
senses.whyCN: 人造之物变成使行动轻松的心智工具。

senses.title: Ease in doing
senses.definition: the quality of being easy to do or use
senses.definitionCN: 容易做或容易使用的性质
senses.example: He answered the questions with facility.
senses.exampleCN: 他轻松地回答了问题。
senses.why: The idea of ease is the abstract side of the same root.
senses.whyCN: 「容易」是同一词根的抽象一面。

intro.en: Facility comes from Latin facilitas, ease, from facilis, easy.
intro.cn: facility 来自拉丁语 facilitas（容易），源头是 facilis（容易的）。

items.en: Facilis means easy to do.
items.cn: facilis 意为容易做的。

items.en: Facilitas means ease or readiness.
items.cn: facilitas 意为容易或敏捷。

items.en: Facilite carries the sense of ease.
items.cn: facilite 带有轻松之义。

items.en: Facility comes to name buildings and equipment.
items.cn: 现代英语中 facility 转而指建筑与设备。

items.en: Facilities usually means a set of services.
items.cn: 当代英语中 facilities 通常指一整套服务设施。

note.en: Facility is a place or ease; faculty is an ability or department.
note.cn: facility 是设施或便利，faculty 则是能力或院系。

entries.definition: an ability or an academic department
too easy or superficial
great happiness or aptness
a useful or pleasant facility
the things needed for an activity
the absence of difficulty

normalIntro.en: Facility covers both the place that helps you and the ease you feel.
normalIntro.cn: facility 既指帮助你的设施，也指你感到的轻松。

normal.en: The campus has excellent library facilities.
normal.cn: 校园有极好的图书馆设施。

normal.en: The clinic lacks basic medical facilities.
normal.cn: 这家诊所缺乏基本医疗设施。

normal.en: She has a facility for remembering names.
normal.cn: 她记名字很有天赋。

normal.en: The new software improves facility of use.
normal.cn: 新软件提升了使用的便利性。

normal.en: They toured the research facility.
normal.cn: 他们参观了研究设施。

abstract.en: Picture a smooth ramp that makes a hard climb easy.
abstract.cn: 想象一条让艰难攀爬变轻松的平滑坡道。

abstract.en: Imagine a hand that finds every task light.
abstract.cn: 想象一只把每件事都做得轻松的手。

abstract.en: Think of a well-equipped room waiting to be used.
abstract.cn: 想象一间设备齐全、随时可用的房间。

examples.en: The city built new facilities for cyclists.
examples.cn: 这座城市为骑行者建造了新设施。

examples.en: His facility with numbers impressed the team.
examples.cn: 他对数字的敏锐让团队印象深刻。

examples.en: The task was completed with surprising facility.
examples.cn: 这项任务完成得异常轻松。

dict_mnemonic.note: 词源记忆 · 拉丁词根
dict_mnemonic.text: facility 与 facile、facilitate 同源于拉丁语 facilis（容易的），凡是「设施」都是为了让事情更容易。

root: facility 源自拉丁语 facilitas（容易），来自 facilis（容易的），与 facilitate、facile 同族。

sensesIntro.en: Facility is a built place or equipment, an easy ability, or the quality of ease.
sensesIntro.cn: facility 指建成的设施设备、轻松的能力，或容易的性质。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: something that makes a task easier.
core.cn: 核心意象：让任务变得更轻松的东西。

branches.en: The base sense is the built place or equipment.
branches.cn: 基础义是建成的场所或设备。

branches.en: The tool becomes a mental ability.
branches.cn: 工具引申为心智能力。

branches.en: Ease is the abstract quality behind both.
branches.cn: 容易是两者背后的抽象性质。

branches.en: Both remove difficulty from an activity.
branches.cn: 两者都消除活动的难度。

branches.en: An ability is shown by acting with ease.
branches.cn: 能力体现为轻松地行动。

intro.en: Facility belongs to the fac- family of Latin origin meaning to do or make.
intro.cn: facility 属于源自拉丁语、意为「做或制造」的 fac- 词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin facere, facilis, and facilitas explain this word family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 facere、facilis 与 facilitas 解释了这个词族。

items.meaning: services and equipment for a purpose

items.exampleCN: 这个应用促进了团队合作。

items.meaning: one who makes a process easier
items.example: The facilitator kept the meeting on track.
items.exampleCN: 协调人让会议保持正轨。

items.example: The sports facility has a pool.
items.exampleCN: 这个体育设施有游泳池。

latinEntries.example: Facere is the root of many English words.
latinEntries.exampleCN: facere 是许多英语词的词根。

definition_zh: 摹本；复制件；传真；传真机
definition_en: an exact copy of a document, picture, or book, or a copy sent over a telephone line
core_image: 原件摊在桌上，旁边一份复制品连折痕和墨点都一模一样
scene: 办公室的机器吱吱响着，一页页纸从出口滑出来。He sent the signed contract by facsimile.
sceneCN: 这里 facsimile 是「传真」（第 2 个义项：用电话线传送的文件副本）；句意：他通过传真把签好的合同发了出去。

derivatives.zh: facsimile 的缩略词，指传真件或传真机，也可转作动词表示用传真发送
tele- 与 fax 合成的旧式说法，指经电话线传送的传真件

senses.title: An exact copy
senses.definition: a copy that reproduces an original exactly in appearance
senses.definitionCN: 在外观上一模一样地再现原件的复制品
senses.example: The museum displays a facsimile of the ancient map.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆展出了一幅古地图的摹本。
senses.why: Latin fac simile means make it similar, so the copy is produced to look just like the original.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 fac simile 意为「把它做得相似」，所以这份复制品被做得和原件一模一样。

senses.title: A copy sent by telephone
senses.definition: a copy of a document transmitted over a telephone line
senses.definitionCN: 通过电话线传送的文件副本
senses.example: Please send the signed page by facsimile.
senses.exampleCN: 请把那页签好的文件传真过来。
senses.why: The copy arrives without the original, and the transmitted sheet keeps the name of the copy.
senses.whyCN: 这份副本到达时原件并不在场，传送过来的纸页便沿用了「复制件」的名字。

senses.title: A fax machine
senses.definition: a machine that sends and receives document copies over a telephone line
senses.definitionCN: 通过电话线发送和接收文件副本的机器
senses.example: The facsimile in the office is out of paper.
senses.exampleCN: 办公室的传真机没纸了。
senses.why: The device takes the name of the copy it produces, by simple metonymy.
senses.whyCN: 这台设备直接借用了它产出的副本之名，这是很自然的转喻。

senses.title: A printed reproduction
senses.definition: a printed edition that reproduces an old book or drawing exactly
senses.definitionCN: 把古书或图画原样复制出来的印刷版本
senses.example: The facsimile edition shows every stain on the original page.
senses.exampleCN: 影印本连原件纸页上的每处污渍都呈现出来。
senses.why: Publishing borrows the word for editions that imitate the original page by page.
senses.whyCN: 出版业借这个词指逐页模仿原件的版本。

intro.en: Facsimile is the Latin phrase fac simile, make it similar, from facere, to make, and similis, like.
intro.cn: facsimile 是拉丁语短语 fac simile（把它做得相似），由 facere（做）与 similis（相似）组成。

items.en: Facere means to make or to do.
items.cn: facere 意为做、制作。

items.en: Similis means like or similar.
items.cn: similis 意为相像的、相似的。

items.en: The instruction fac simile means make it similar.
items.cn: 短语 fac simile 是一句指令，意为「把它做得相似」。

items.en: Facsimile becomes one noun for an exact copy.
items.cn: 在中世纪拉丁语里，facsimile 并成一个名词，指一模一样的复制件。

items.en: English uses facsimile for copies of writing and seals.
items.cn: 十七世纪英语用 facsimile 指文字与印章的复制件。

items.en: Telegraphy shortens facsimile to fax.
items.cn: 电报与电话时代把 facsimile 缩略为 fax。

note.en: Facsimile joins the Latin roots facere and similis, and its short form fax now dominates everyday speech.
note.cn: facsimile 由拉丁语词根 facere 与 similis 合成，其缩略形式 fax 如今统治了日常表达。

entries.definition: a copy of a document sent by telephone
entries.definitionCN: 经电话线传送的文件副本

entries.definition: a comparison that uses like or as
almost the same
a thing made to look like another thing
a copy of a work of art or of a text
an exact second copy of something
entries.definitionCN: 复制件；一模一样的副本

normalIntro.en: Facsimile is a small Latin order, make it similar, turned into a noun for an exact copy.
normalIntro.cn: facsimile 是一句简短的拉丁语指令「把它做得相似」，后来变成一个名词，指一模一样的复制件。

normal.en: Fac simile is Latin for make it similar.
normal.cn: fac simile 是拉丁语「把它做得相似」。

normal.en: A facsimile of the letter hangs in the museum.
normal.cn: 这封信的摹本挂在博物馆里。

normal.en: Send the form by facsimile if the post is slow.
normal.cn: 如果邮寄太慢，就用传真把表格发过去。

normal.en: The facsimile edition copies every mark of the first printing.
normal.cn: 影印本复制了初版上的每一处痕迹。

normal.en: Fax is just a short way of saying facsimile.
normal.cn: fax 只是 facsimile 的简短说法。

abstract.en: Picture a photocopier placing a perfect twin beside the original.
abstract.cn: 想象复印机把一份完美的双胞胎放在原件旁边。

abstract.en: Imagine a sheet sliding out of a machine far away, still warm.
abstract.cn: 想象一张纸从远处的机器里滑出来，还带着温度。

abstract.en: Think of a desk machine humming as it copies a signature.
abstract.cn: 想象桌上的机器嗡鸣着，正在复制一个签名。

examples.en: The archive keeps a facsimile of the first edition.
examples.cn: 档案馆保存着初版的摹本。

examples.en: We received the contract by facsimile this morning.
examples.cn: 今天早上我们通过传真收到了合同。

examples.en: The facsimile reproduces the original colours faithfully.
examples.cn: 这件摹本忠实地再现了原件的色彩。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「法克西米利」，可拆成「发个相似的」：把原件发一份相似的过去，就是传真与摹本；这只是读音联想，并非词源。

root: 拉丁语 facere（做）+ similis（相似）→ 拉丁短语 fac simile（把它做得相似）→ 中世纪拉丁语 facsimile（复制件）→ 英语 facsimile，核心义「照着原件做出相似的一份」。

sensesIntro.en: Facsimile begins as an exact copy, extends to the copy sent by telephone, then to the machine, and finally to printed reproductions.
sensesIntro.cn: facsimile 从「一模一样的复制件」出发，扩展到电话传送的副本，再指传送它的机器，最后指印刷的影印本。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a copy laid beside its original, mark for mark.
core.cn: 核心意象：复制件摊在原件旁边，连墨点都一致。

branches.en: The copy made to look like the original is the base sense.
branches.cn: 照着原件做得相像的复制件是基础义。

branches.en: A copy sent over a line keeps the name of the copy.
branches.cn: 经线路传送的副本仍沿用「复制件」之名。

branches.en: The machine is named after the copy it makes.
branches.cn: 机器以它做出的副本得名。

branches.en: Printing borrows the word for faithful reprints.
branches.cn: 印刷业借这个词指忠实的翻印本。

branches.en: Both the copy and the machine promise an exact likeness.
branches.cn: 复制件与机器都承诺「一模一样」。

intro.en: Facsimile is built from Latin fac, the order form of facere meaning do, and simile, the like form of similis meaning similar, with fax as its clipped child.
intro.cn: facsimile 由拉丁语 fac（做，facere 的命令式）与 simile（相似的，similis 的中性形式）构成，缩略形式 fax 由它而来。

latinIntro.en: Latin fac means do, and simile means a similar thing; together the phrase fac simile orders an exact copy.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 fac 意为「做」，simile 意为「相似之物」；两者合起来，短语 fac simile 就是一道做出一模一样复制件的命令。

items.meaning: do, make (the order form of facere)
items.example: Fac is the short order form inside the phrase.
items.exampleCN: fac 是短语里那个简短的命令式形式。
similis 提供「相似」的那一半。

items.meaning: a similar thing (the like form of similis)
items.meaningCN: 相似之物（similis 的中性形式）
items.example: Simile is the like form that also gives the English noun for a comparison.
items.exampleCN: simile 是「相似」的形式，也给出英语里表示比较的名词。

items.example: The phrase fac simile gives the order for a copy.
items.exampleCN: 短语 fac simile 就是复制一道的命令。

items.example: The library holds facsimiles of old maps.
items.exampleCN: 图书馆藏有古地图的摹本。

items.example: Please fax the form to us.
The two copies are very similar.
The facsimile edition is bound in cloth.

latinEntries.example: Facere is the verb behind fac.
latinEntries.exampleCN: facere 是 fac 背后的动词。

latinEntries.example: Fac is the first half of fac simile.
latinEntries.exampleCN: fac 是 fac simile 的前一半。

latinEntries.example: Similis gives the like form simile.
latinEntries.exampleCN: similis 给出「相似」形式 simile。

latinEntries.example: Simile is the second half of fac simile.
latinEntries.exampleCN: simile 是 fac simile 的后一半。

latinEntries.example: Fac simile is the phrase behind the noun.
latinEntries.exampleCN: fac simile 是名词 facsimile 背后的短语。

definition_zh: 派系的；派性的；好结党的；煽动不和的
definition_en: relating to a faction, or inclined to form factions and stir up dissent
core_image: 一间屋子里的人分成两拨，各自围坐，互不看向对方
scene: 会议室里的人分成了两拨，各自低声商量，谁也不肯让步。The factious members refused to back the plan of the whole group.
sceneCN: 这里 factious 是「好结党的、制造派系的」（第 2 个义项：倾向拉帮结派）；句意：这些好结党的成员拒绝支持整个小组的方案。

pos.zh: 派系的；派性的；好结党的；煽动不和的

derivatives.zh: 派系；小团体；由拉丁语 factio 直接进入英语，指抱团的一伙人
派性地；好结党地；factious 加 -ly 构成的副词
好结党；派性；factious 加 -ness 构成的名词

senses.title: Of a faction
senses.definition: relating to a faction, or arising from loyalties inside a faction
senses.definitionCN: 与某个派系有关，或由派系内部的忠诚引起的
senses.example: The factious split left the club with two rival boards.
senses.exampleCN: 派系分裂让俱乐部出现了两个对立的理事会。
senses.why: Factious comes from Latin factiosus, from factio, a party, so the adjective first names what belongs to a party.
senses.whyCN: factious 来自拉丁语 factiosus，源于 factio（党团），所以这个形容词首先指「属于某一派」的东西。

senses.title: Given to forming factions
senses.titleCN: 好结党的；爱搞小团体的
senses.definition: inclined to form small groups that push their own interests
senses.definitionCN: 倾向于结成小团体并推行自身利益
senses.example: A factious minority blocked every compromise.
senses.exampleCN: 一个爱搞小团体的少数派阻挠了每一次妥协。
senses.why: The Latin noun already meant a group banded together for a cause, so the adjective came to describe the habit of building such groups.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语名词本就指为某个事业抱团的一伙人，于是这个形容词也用来形容惯于搭建这种小团体的习性。

senses.title: Stirring up dissent
senses.titleCN: 煽动不和的；制造内讧的
senses.definition: causing division and disagreement inside a group
senses.definitionCN: 在团体内部制造分裂与争执
senses.example: His factious speeches turned allies into rivals.
senses.exampleCN: 他煽动不和的演讲把盟友变成了对手。
senses.why: When a faction pushes its own line against the whole, the result is dissent, and English extended the adjective to that turbulent effect.
senses.whyCN: 当派系把自身主张压过整体，结果就是内部分歧，英语便把这一形容词扩展到这种搅动不和的效果。

senses.title: Narrowly partisan
senses.titleCN: 偏袒小团体的；宗派主义的
senses.definition: showing loyalty to a faction rather than to the whole group
senses.definitionCN: 忠于小团体而非整个集体
senses.example: Factious loyalty made an honest vote impossible.
senses.exampleCN: 偏袒小团体的忠诚让公正表决无法进行。
senses.why: The core idea of a faction is a part set against the whole, and this sense names the attitude that puts the part first.
senses.whyCN: 派系的核心意象是「部分对抗整体」，这个义项正是指把部分放在首位的态度。

intro.en: Factious comes from Latin factiosus, full of faction, from factio, a party, and facere, to do.
intro.cn: factious 来自拉丁语 factiosus（充满派性的），源于 factio（党团），再往上是 facere（做）。

items.en: Facere means to do or to make.
items.cn: facere 意为做、制造。

items.en: Factio first means a doing, then a party banded together for action.
items.cn: factio 先指「做」，再指为行动抱团而成的党团。

items.en: Factiosus describes a person full of faction or given to party strife.
items.cn: factiosus 形容充满派性、热衷党争的人。

items.en: English borrows factious for party strife inside a state or a group.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪借入 factious，用于国家或团体内部的党争。

items.en: Modern English keeps it for divisive behaviour inside parties and committees.
items.cn: 现代英语用它指政党与委员会内部的分裂行为。

note.en: Factious belongs to the Latin family of facere, and it is easily confused with fractious and fictitious.
note.cn: factious 属于 facere 的拉丁词族，又容易与 fractious、fictitious 混淆。

entries.definition: a small group inside a larger one, often in conflict with it
entries.definitionCN: 派系；大团体内部常与他派冲突的小团体

entries.definition: irritable and hard to control
entries.definitionCN: 易怒难管的；只是拼写与 factious 相近，其来源与 frangere（打碎）有关，与 factious 不同源

entries.definition: invented rather than real
entries.definitionCN: 虚构的；只是拼写相近，其来源是 fingere（捏造），与 factious 不同源

entries.definition: strongly loyal to one party or group
entries.definitionCN: 党派的；坚定拥护某一派别的

entries.definition: encouraging rebellion against authority
entries.definitionCN: 煽动叛乱的；鼓动反抗权威的

entries.definition: tending to form exclusive small groups
entries.definitionCN: 小圈子式的；爱搞排他小团体的

normalIntro.en: Factious shares its spine with faction: faction is a part, and factious describes the part that pulls away.
normalIntro.cn: factious 与 faction 同根：faction 是「一部分」，factious 则形容那部分人往外拉。

normal.en: Faction is the noun and factious the adjective: a factious group is a faction at work.
normal.cn: faction 是名词，factious 是形容词：factious 的团体就是正在运作的派系。

normal.en: The Latin facere, to do, lies under both fact and faction.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 facere（做）同时藏在 fact 与 faction 底下。

normal.en: A factious spirit puts the small group before the whole.
normal.cn: 「factious spirit」把小团体放在整体之前。

normal.en: Keep factious apart from fractious: a fractious child is irritable, a factious member is divisive.
normal.cn: 把 factious 与 fractious 分开：fractious 的孩子脾气坏，factious 的成员搞分裂。

normal.en: Factious behaviour inside a party is what the word names in politics.
normal.cn: 政党内部那种拉帮结派的行为，正是这个词在政治语境里所指的。

abstract.en: Picture a round table split into two halves, each turned away from the other.
abstract.cn: 想象一张圆桌裂成两半，两边各自转开，不看对方。

abstract.en: Imagine a small knot of people whispering in a corner while the meeting stalls.
abstract.cn: 想象一小撮人在角落里低声耳语，会议因此停滞。

abstract.en: Think of a spark landing in dry grass and splitting a field in two.
abstract.cn: 想象一粒火星落进干草，把一片田野烧成两半。

examples.en: The factious quarrel delayed the vote for a week.
examples.cn: 派系争吵让表决推迟了一周。

examples.en: Every factious clique wanted its own candidate on the list.
examples.cn: 每个好结党的小圈子都想把自己的候选人列入名单。

examples.en: A factious spirit can ruin a volunteer group.
examples.cn: 派性情绪能毁掉一个志愿者团体。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「factious」读起来像「法克舍斯」——一伙人火气上来，各自拉帮、彼此较劲，正是好结党的样子；这只是谐音联想，并非词源。

root: 拉丁语 facere（做、制造）→ factio（做；为行动抱团的一伙人，即派系）→ factiosus（充满派性的）→ 英语 factious，核心义「属于某一派，并为这一派去争」。

sensesIntro.en: Factious begins with what belongs to a faction, then covers the habit of forming factions, the dissent it stirs, and the narrow loyalty behind it.
sensesIntro.cn: factious 先指属于某个派系，再指惯于结党的习性、由此搅起的内讧，以及背后的宗派式忠诚。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one room divided into two camps that no longer face each other.
core.cn: 核心意象：一间屋子分成两拨人，彼此不再正眼相看。

branches.en: Belonging to a faction is the first and most literal sense.
branches.cn: 属于某个派系，是最直白的第一义。

branches.en: The habit of forming factions grows out of the noun.
branches.cn: 惯于结党这一习性，是从名词义长出来的。

branches.en: Dissent is what factional pushing produces inside a group.
branches.cn: 内讧是派系施压在一个团体内部造成的结果。

branches.en: Both the belonging and the narrow loyalty describe the same partisan tie.
branches.cn: 归属与偏袒讲的是同一条派系纽带。

branches.en: A factious member both forms the clique and stirs the quarrel.
branches.cn: 好结党的人既结成小圈子，也搅起争吵。

intro.en: Factious is built on the Latin noun factio, a faction, with the adjective suffix -ous marking fullness.
intro.cn: factious 建立在拉丁语名词 factio（派系）之上，形容词后缀 -ous 表示「充满……」。

latinIntro.en: Latin factio means a party or faction, and factiosus means full of faction; English took the adjective from that stem.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 factio 意为党团、派系，factiosus 意为充满派性的；英语从这个词干取来形容词。

items.example: Facere is the verb behind the whole family.
items.exampleCN: facere 是整个词族背后的动词。

items.meaning: a doing; a party or faction
items.example: Factio gives English faction and factious.
items.exampleCN: factio 给出英语的 faction 与 factious。

items.meaningCN: 充满派性的；煽动不和的
items.example: Factiosus is the direct Latin source.
items.exampleCN: factiosus 是直接的拉丁语来源。

items.meaning: full of, having the quality of
items.example: The suffix -ous turns nouns into adjectives.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ous 把名词变成形容词。
factious 保留了拉丁语含义。

items.meaning: a small party within a larger group
items.example: Faction is the noun of the same stem.
Factiously describes acting for a faction.

latinEntries.example: Facere is the verb behind faction.
latinEntries.exampleCN: facere 是 faction 背后的动词。

latinEntries.example: Factiosus is the direct source of factious.
latinEntries.exampleCN: factiosus 是 factious 的直接来源。

definition_zh: 因素；要素；因数；因子
definition_en: one of the things that influences a result; a number that divides another exactly or is multiplied with others; a substance that takes part in a process
core_image: 几股力量共同推动一个结果，其中一股就是 factor
scene: 价格是影响选择的关键因素。Price is a key factor in the choice.
sceneCN: 这里 factor 是「因素、要素」（第 1 个义项）；句意：价格是影响选择的关键因素。

senses.title: An influence on a result
senses.definition: one of the things that influences a result
senses.definitionCN: 影响结果的事物之一
senses.example: Cost was the main factor in our decision.
senses.exampleCN: 成本是我们决定的主要因素。
senses.why: The core sense is a maker of an outcome.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是结果的促成者。

senses.title: A mathematical multiplier
senses.definition: a number that is multiplied with another or divides another exactly
senses.definitionCN: 与另一数相乘或能整除另一数的数
senses.example: Three and four are factors of twelve.
senses.exampleCN: 三和四是十二的因数。
senses.why: A number that helps build a product is a maker in arithmetic.
senses.whyCN: 帮助构成乘积的数在算术中也是「制造者」。

senses.title: A biological substance
senses.definition: a substance that takes part in a body process
senses.definitionCN: 参与身体某种过程的物质
senses.example: The doctor tested for a clotting factor.
senses.exampleCN: 医生检测了一种凝血因子。
senses.why: An active substance is treated as an agent in a process.
senses.whyCN: 起作用的物质被视为过程的动因。

intro.en: Factor comes from Latin factor, a doer, from facere, to do.
intro.cn: factor 来自拉丁语 factor（做事者），源头 facere（做）。

items.en: Factor means a maker or doer.
items.cn: factor 意为制造者或行动者。

items.en: Facere means to do or make.
items.cn: facere 意为做或制造。

items.en: Factor names a business agent.
items.cn: 十五世纪 factor 指商业代理人。

items.en: The word comes to mean a multiplier.
items.cn: 数学中该词转为因数。

items.en: Factor means any influence on a result.
items.cn: 现代英语中 factor 指影响结果的任何因素。

note.en: A factor influences a result; a factory makes goods.
note.cn: factor 影响结果，factory 则制造产品。

entries.definition: something known to be true
a building where goods are made
an ability or department
one part of a whole
something that makes a result happen
one part of a larger system

normalIntro.en: A factor is one of the forces that makes a result happen.
normalIntro.cn: factor 是促成结果的诸般力量之一。

normal.en: Weather was a factor in the delay.
normal.cn: 天气是延误的一个因素。

normal.en: Diet is a risk factor for heart disease.
normal.cn: 饮食是心脏病的风险因素。

normal.en: We must factor in the cost of travel.
normal.cn: 我们必须把旅费考虑在内。

normal.en: Two is a factor of eight.
normal.cn: 二是八的因数。

normal.en: Labour is a factor of production.
normal.cn: 劳动力是生产要素。

abstract.en: Picture several hands pushing one ball.
abstract.cn: 想象好几只手推同一个球。

abstract.en: Imagine numbers stacked to form a product.
abstract.cn: 想象几个数字叠成一个乘积。

abstract.en: Think of a chemical messenger switching a process on.
abstract.cn: 想象一种化学信使启动某个过程。

examples.en: Several factors led to the company's success.
examples.cn: 有几个因素促成了这家公司的成功。

examples.en: The teacher factored effort into the grade.
examples.cn: 老师把努力程度计入了成绩。

examples.en: Five is a prime factor of twenty.
examples.cn: 五是二十的一个质因数。

dict_mnemonic.note: 词源记忆 · 拉丁词根
dict_mnemonic.text: factor 原指「做事的人」，来自 facere（做）；能左右结果的那股力量，也就成了「因素」。

root: factor 源自拉丁语 factor（做事者、制造者），来自 facere（做），由「行动者」引申为影响结果的「因素」。

sensesIntro.en: Factor is an influence on a result, a multiplying number, or an active body substance.
sensesIntro.cn: factor 指影响结果的因素、相乘的因数，或体内起作用的因子。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one of several forces shaping a result.
core.cn: 核心意象：塑造结果的诸股力量之一。

branches.en: The base sense is an influence on an outcome.
branches.cn: 基础义是影响结果的因素。

branches.en: Arithmetic treats a multiplier as a maker.
branches.cn: 算术把乘数视为「制造者」。

branches.en: Medicine treats an active substance as an agent.
branches.cn: 医学把活性物质视为动因。

branches.en: Both senses involve building a larger result.
branches.cn: 两个义项都涉及构成更大的结果。

branches.en: Physical and abstract forces can both be factors.
branches.cn: 具体与抽象的力量都可能是因素。

intro.en: Factor is built from the Latin root fact- plus the agent ending -or.
intro.cn: factor 由拉丁词根 fact- 加施动后缀 -or 构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin factor and facere explain factor and its mathematical relatives.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 factor 与 facere 解释了 factor 及其数学同族词。

items.example: Tax was factored into the price.
Factoring in inflation changes the figure.

items.exampleCN: 把这个表达式因式分解。

items.meaning: a product of all positive integers up to a number
items.example: Five factorial equals one hundred twenty.
items.exampleCN: 五的阶乘等于一百二十。

items.meaning: an input such as labour or land
items.example: Capital is a factor of production.

latinEntries.exampleCN: facere 提供 fact- 词干。

latinEntries.example: Factus explains the stem in compound words.
latinEntries.exampleCN: factus 解释了复合词中的词干。

definition_zh: 可因式分解的；可分解因数的
definition_en: able to be expressed as a product of factors
core_image: 一块长条积木拆成几块小的，还能拼回原来的长度
scene: 黑板上写着一长串代数式，老师用粉笔把它拆成两个括号相乘。The expression on the board is factorable into two simple brackets.
sceneCN: 这里 factorable 是「可因式分解的」（第 1 个义项：能写成几个因式的乘积）；句意：黑板上的式子可以分解成两个简单的括号。

pos.zh: 可因式分解的；可分解因数的

collocations.zh: 在整数范围内可因式分解的

derivatives.zh: 因素；因子；因数；由拉丁语 factor（做事者）进入英语
可分解性；factorable 加 -ity 构成的名词
因式分解；factor 加 -ization 构成的名词
把……分解因式；factor 加 -ize 构成的动词

senses.title: Able to be broken into factors
senses.definition: able to be written as a product of simpler expressions
senses.definitionCN: 能写成几个更简单的式子相乘的形式
senses.example: Every factorable quadratic can be solved by splitting the middle term.
senses.exampleCN: 每个可因式分解的二次式都能用拆中项的方法解出。
senses.why: Factorable joins factor to -able, so it names what can be turned into factors.
senses.whyCN: factorable 由 factor 加 -able 构成，所以它指「能够被化成因式的东西」。

senses.title: Able to be factored over a given set
senses.titleCN: 在指定数集内可分解的
senses.definition: able to be factored using numbers of a stated set, such as integers or reals
senses.definitionCN: 能在指定数集（如整数或实数）内完成因式分解的
senses.example: The polynomial is factorable over the reals but not over the integers.
senses.exampleCN: 这个多项式在实数范围内可分解，在整数范围内则不行。
senses.why: Mathematics needs to say where a factorization is allowed, and the adjective extends to that restricted sense.
senses.whyCN: 数学上需要说明分解在哪个范围内进行，这个形容词便延伸出这种带限制的用法。

senses.title: Able to be split into divisors
senses.definition: of a whole number, able to be written as a product of smaller whole numbers
senses.definitionCN: 指整数能写成几个更小整数的乘积
senses.example: Twelve is factorable as two times two times three.
senses.exampleCN: 十二可以分解成二乘二乘三。
senses.why: The same factor idea applies to whole numbers, where factors are divisors rather than algebraic terms.
senses.whyCN: 同样的「因子」概念也用在整数上，只不过那里的因子是约数而非代数项。

intro.en: Factorable is an English construction of factor plus -able; factor itself comes from Latin factor, a maker, from facere, to do.
intro.cn: factorable 是英语用 factor 加 -able 构成的词；factor 本身来自拉丁语 factor（做事者），源于 facere（做）。

items.en: Facere means to do or make, and factor names the one who does.
items.cn: facere 意为做、制造，factor 则指做事的人。

items.en: Factor keeps the sense of a doer or maker.
items.cn: factor 保留「做事者、制造者」的含义。

items.en: English factor gains the arithmetic sense of a number that multiplies another.
items.cn: 英语中 factor 获得算术义，指与另一数相乘的数。

items.en: English adds -able to factor, naming what can be reduced to factors.
items.cn: 英语给 factor 加上 -able，用来指能被化成因式的东西。

items.en: Modern algebra and number theory use factorable for expressions and integers alike.
items.cn: 现代代数与数论把 factorable 同时用于式子和整数。

note.en: Factorable sits in the factor family, next to factorize and factorization, and is easily confused with factional and factious.
note.cn: factorable 属于 factor 词族，与 factorize、factorization 相邻，又容易和 factional、factious 混淆。

entries.definition: a number or expression that divides another exactly
